description:
Chain ID Check: network identifier on Ethereum mainnet. Ethereum mainnet chain id via eth_chainId: returns the hex result and its decimal value, read live from an Ethereum RPC node. Use it as a paid connectivity and chain check before an agent signs or reads on mainnet.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_eth_reads_v1/eth_mainnet_eth_chainid. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
Measured output: {"chain": "ethereum", "hex": "0x1", "method": "eth_chainId", "ok": true, "result": 1, "service": "x402_chain_reads_v1.eth_chainid"}
name: x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_eth_chainid
